text: What time do you usually get up in the morning?
ipa: /wʌt taɪm də jə ˈjuːʒuəli ɡet ʌp ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
meaningVi: Bạn thường dậy lúc mấy giờ sáng?
example: A: What time do you usually get up in the morning? — B: Around six thirty.

text: I usually take the bus to work.
ipa: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli teɪk ðə bʌs tə wɜːrk/
meaningVi: Tôi thường đi làm bằng xe buýt.
example: A: How do you get to the office? — B: I usually take the bus to work.

text: I'm so tired, I didn't sleep well last night.
ipa: /aɪm soʊ ˈtaɪərd aɪ ˈdɪdənt sliːp wel læst naɪt/
meaningVi: Mệt quá, tối qua tôi ngủ không ngon.
example: A: You look sleepy. — B: I'm so tired, I didn't sleep well last night.

text: Can you help me with the dishes after dinner?
ipa: /kən jə help mi wɪð ðə ˈdɪʃɪz ˈæftər ˈdɪnər/
meaningVi: Ăn tối xong bạn rửa bát phụ tôi một tay được không?
example: A: Can you help me with the dishes after dinner? — B: Sure, I'll dry them.

text: Whose turn is it to take out the trash?
ipa: /huːz tɜːrn ɪz ɪt tə teɪk aʊt ðə træʃ/
meaningVi: Hôm nay đến lượt ai đi đổ rác vậy?
example: A: The bin is full. Whose turn is it to take out the trash? — B: Mine, sorry!

text: I need to do the laundry this weekend.
ipa: /aɪ niːd tə duː ðə ˈlɔːndri ðɪs ˈwiːkend/
meaningVi: Cuối tuần này tôi phải giặt đồ.
example: A: Want to go shopping on Saturday? — B: Sorry, I need to do the laundry this weekend.

text: I'm going to take a quick shower before dinner.
ipa: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə teɪk ə kwɪk ˈʃaʊər bɪˈfɔːr ˈdɪnər/
meaningVi: Tôi đi tắm nhanh một cái rồi ăn tối nhé.
example: A: Dinner is almost ready. — B: OK, I'm going to take a quick shower before dinner.

text: Did you remember to lock the front door?
ipa: /dɪd jə rɪˈmembər tə lɑːk ðə frʌnt dɔːr/
meaningVi: Bạn có nhớ khóa cửa trước chưa?
example: A: Did you remember to lock the front door? — B: Yes, I checked it twice.

text: The traffic was terrible this morning, so I was late.
ipa: /ðə ˈtræfɪk wəz ˈterəbəl ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ soʊ aɪ wəz leɪt/
meaningVi: Sáng nay kẹt xe kinh khủng nên tôi đến muộn.
example: Sorry, everyone. The traffic was terrible this morning, so I was late.

text: I always have a cup of coffee before I start work.
ipa: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz hæv ə kʌp əv ˈkɔːfi bɪˈfɔːr aɪ stɑːrt wɜːrk/
meaningVi: Lúc nào tôi cũng uống một ly cà phê rồi mới bắt đầu làm việc.
example: A: Coffee again? — B: Yes, I always have a cup of coffee before I start work.

text: What do you usually have for breakfast?
ipa: /wʌt də jə ˈjuːʒuəli hæv fər ˈbrekfəst/
meaningVi: Bữa sáng bạn thường ăn gì?
example: A: What do you usually have for breakfast? — B: Just some bread and milk.

text: I'm heading out now, see you this evening.
ipa: /aɪm ˈhedɪŋ aʊt naʊ siː jə ðɪs ˈiːvnɪŋ/
meaningVi: Tôi đi đây, tối gặp lại nhé.
example: A: I'm heading out now, see you this evening. — B: OK, have a good day!

text: Could you turn off the lights when you leave?
ipa: /kʊd jə tɜːrn ɔːf ðə laɪts wen jə liːv/
meaningVi: Lúc đi ra nhớ tắt đèn giúp tôi nhé.
example: A: I'm going to stay a bit longer. — B: OK. Could you turn off the lights when you leave?

text: It takes me about thirty minutes to get to work.
ipa: /ɪt teɪks mi əˈbaʊt ˈθɜːrti ˈmɪnɪts tə ɡet tə wɜːrk/
meaningVi: Tôi đi làm mất khoảng ba mươi phút.
example: A: Do you live far from the office? — B: Not really. It takes me about thirty minutes to get to work.

text: I usually go to bed around eleven o'clock.
ipa: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡoʊ tə bed əˈraʊnd ɪˈlevən əˈklɑːk/
meaningVi: Tôi thường đi ngủ tầm mười một giờ.
example: A: Do you stay up late? — B: Not really. I usually go to bed around eleven o'clock.

text: I'm home!
ipa: /aɪm hoʊm/
meaningVi: Mình về rồi đây!
example: I'm home! Is anyone here?

text: Do we need anything from the supermarket?
ipa: /də wi niːd ˈeniθɪŋ frəm ðə ˈsuːpərˌmɑːrkɪt/
meaningVi: Nhà mình có cần mua gì ở siêu thị không?
example: A: I'm going out. Do we need anything from the supermarket? — B: Yes, eggs and milk, please.

text: I forgot to set my alarm last night.
ipa: /aɪ fərˈɡɑːt tə set maɪ əˈlɑːrm læst naɪt/
meaningVi: Tối qua tôi quên đặt báo thức.
example: A: Why did you get up so late? — B: I forgot to set my alarm last night.

text: Let's clean the house together on Sunday morning.
ipa: /lets kliːn ðə haʊs təˈɡeðər ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
meaningVi: Sáng Chủ nhật cả nhà mình cùng dọn nhà nhé.
example: A: The house is such a mess. — B: Let's clean the house together on Sunday morning.

text: I usually cook dinner at home on weekdays.
ipa: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli kʊk ˈdɪnər æt hoʊm ɑːn ˈwiːkdeɪz/
meaningVi: Ngày thường tôi hay tự nấu bữa tối ở nhà.
example: A: Do you eat out a lot? — B: Not really. I usually cook dinner at home on weekdays.

text: The washing machine is broken again.
ipa: /ðə ˈwɑːʃɪŋ məˈʃiːn ɪz ˈbroʊkən əˈɡen/
meaningVi: Máy giặt lại hỏng nữa rồi.
example: A: The washing machine is broken again. — B: Oh no, I'll call the repairman.

text: I walk my dog in the park every evening.
ipa: /aɪ wɔːk maɪ dɔːɡ ɪn ðə pɑːrk ˈevri ˈiːvnɪŋ/
meaningVi: Tối nào tôi cũng dắt chó đi dạo trong công viên.
example: A: Do you get much exercise? — B: A little. I walk my dog in the park every evening.

text: Can you pick up the kids from school today?
ipa: /kən jə pɪk ʌp ðə kɪdz frəm skuːl təˈdeɪ/
meaningVi: Hôm nay anh đón các con ở trường được không?
example: A: I have a meeting until six. Can you pick up the kids from school today? — B: No problem.

text: I need to charge my phone before I go out.
ipa: /aɪ niːd tə tʃɑːrdʒ maɪ foʊn bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ɡoʊ aʊt/
meaningVi: Tôi phải sạc điện thoại đã rồi mới ra ngoài.
example: A: Are you ready to go? — B: Almost. I need to charge my phone before I go out.

text: Don't forget to water the plants while I'm away.
ipa: /doʊnt fərˈɡet tə ˈwɔːtər ðə plænts waɪl aɪm əˈweɪ/
meaningVi: Tôi đi vắng thì nhớ tưới cây giúp tôi nhé.
example: A: I'll be back on Friday. Don't forget to water the plants while I'm away. — B: Don't worry, I won't.
